summary: Shared ellipsis action-menu label fix after Owner Production screenshots showed blank menu rows on Topics and Navigation. Overflow actions now render real DOM text labels instead of depending on CSS attr() pseudo-content, and favorite labels stay synchronized after toggles. The shared fix covers resource/navigation rows, Channels, Courses, Topics, Tools and Software overflow containers; Watch inherits the shared resource-action path. Projects already use real text in their independent project menu. No Navigation/Shared Shell geometry, data model, schema, migration, auth/security, provider, or updater mechanism change. Production remains Owner manual.
